messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we're planning a small rollout next week to add two fields to audit events: `kms_key_id` (masked) and `rbac_action`. This is part of the KMS integration and RBAC audit coverage work. Need a short customer validation plan + changelog copy. Any red flags?

alex: +1. do we already have a schema diff? also how will this affect customers who are validating event contract tests?

maria: I've sketched a diff. Major compatibility: existing required fields unchanged; new fields are optional. We'll publish a schema v4 with migration notes. Jamal can share sample payloads for customer QA.

jamal: sample event (sensitive bits masked):
```json
{
  "event_type": "secret.grpc.kms.decrypt",
  "timestamp": "2026-05-14T15:22:10Z",
  "actor": {"id": "svc-1234", "type": "service"},
  "resource": {"id": "proj-987", "type": "model"},
  "rbac_action": "kms:decrypt",
  "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:***:key/abcd-****-ef01",
  "outcome": "success"
}
```

sasha: Important: we must not leak full key ARNs to customers who don't have access. Plan is to mask key ids in events for tenant customers, but include full id for private deployments when customer requested it in contract. Add that to docs.

maria: Agreed. For hosted API, mask to `kms_key_id: "***-redwood"` and include `kms_key_alias` when available. Add RBAC note: `rbac_action` values will follow internal convention (`rbac:allow/deny` + resource verb).

elaine-cs: For customer-facing validation: propose two flow options — 1) automated schema check we run for customers (beta) 2) downloadable sample payloads + a small test harness in the docs they can run locally. We'll prepare email copy for customers who have audit contracts.

alex: QA checklist idea:
- schema v4 published in /docs/audit/events (with diff link)
- sample payloads + masked/unmasked examples
- migration notes: optional fields, contract tests unaffected
- RBAC enum list + mapping table
- retention/PII note for `kms_key_id` masking policy
- e2e test run by eng on staging + canary on a small set of customers

maria: Proposed changelog blurb (customer-facing):
> Weve added optional audit fields to provide better KMS and RBAC visibility. `kms_key_id` (masked by default) and `rbac_action` will appear in relevant audit events. These fields are optional and should be backward compatible with existing integrations. See /docs/audit/events for migration guidance and sample payloads.

sasha: Minor policy note: add to compliance section that full KMS identifiers are treated as sensitive and retention is aligned to customer export rules.

jamal: Implementation timeline:
- Wed: publish schema draft and sample events
- Thu: internal eng QA on staging (run contract tests)
- Fri: security review sign-off (SAST/PII items)
- Mon next week: canary rollout to 5% of hosted traffic + notify customers in the canary cohort

maria: Who owns the customer notification copy? Elaine?

elaine-cs: I can draft the email + changelog entry. Will link to the validation harness and provide a contact for questions. ETA end of day Thu.

alex: One more question: RBAC change — do we need a WARN window for teams that parse `actor.type`? We'll keep `actor.type` expansion additive and documented. No breaking changes expected.

maria: Correct. We'll add a small "compatibility" section calling out additive enums and recommended lenient parsing.

security-bot: deploy-bot: schema-v4 draft published to `docs-staging` (build 2026.05.14-22) :white_check_mark:

maria: Great. Next actions assigned: Jamal: finalize sample payloads + masking examples; Alex: QA checklist + run contract tests on staging; Elaine: draft customer communications; Sasha: add policy blurb on PII and retention. We'll sync Friday 10am to confirm canary. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
